name: ComEd
notes: Real map is the Kubra stormcenter iframe at /outages/experiencing-an-outage/outage-map (old /outages/outage-map is a 404). Reports: county, township/village, Chicago ward.

name: DTE Electric
notes: Confirmed seed. Utility-wide total only: Kubra view config has reports=[] (no county/ZIP report) and outage.dteenergy.com/situations.json only repeats the total. Incident detail exists only as map tiles.

name: Consumers Energy
notes: Self-hosted ArcGIS MapServer; layer 3 is one row per county (61), OUTAGE_COUNT is customers out and matches /OutageMap/OutageMap/GetOutageCount. Layer 4 is by postal office if ZIP-like data is wanted.

name: Ameren (Illinois and Missouri)
notes: One Kubra view with two non-overlapping totals: index 0 = Ameren Illinois (56697, ~1.22M served), index 1 = Ameren Missouri/Union Electric (19436, ~1.26M served). sumTotals combines them; the county report is one tree with Illinois and Missouri states, so it is listed once here to avoid double counting.

name: Evergy
notes: One Kubra view for all of Evergy: Missouri Metro, Missouri West and Kansas.

name: FirstEnergy Ohio (Ohio Edison, CEI, Toledo Edison)
notes: One combined Ohio view (~2.1M served) covering all three operating companies, no per-company split. Report tree is state > county > township.

name: AEP Ohio
notes: Kubra; county, ZIP, operating-area and district reports (county first). ~1.53M served.

name: We Energies (Wisconsin Electric)
notes: Public JSON list of open incidents, one row each with Slices[0] holding AffectedCusts plus City/County/Zip/Region and their served counts (CountyCusts etc). Rows are incidents, not county sums, so a county can repeat; an idle system returns []. Territory includes Upper Michigan, which this config labels WI.

name: Wisconsin Public Service
notes: Same WEC Energy platform and schema as We Energies; returned [] when idle so the incident row shape is taken from the We Energies feed (same code). Includes Upper Michigan service area.

name: NIPSCO
notes: Public NiSource API behind the NIPSCO outage page; works with no diagId. Rows are per city/ZIP with customers affected. /nisource-api/ldc/GetPowerOutages gives the incident list with lat/lng if ever needed.

name: Xcel Energy
notes: One DataCapable feed for every Xcel company. Each row names its state, so counties resolve correctly.

name: Indiana Michigan Power (AEP)
notes: Kubra; county, ZIP, district and operating-area reports with state grouping (IN and MI). ~610k served.

name: AES Indiana
notes: Public XML behind the outage map. Utility-wide total only; the XML also lists incidents (CustAffected, Lat, Long) but no county, and the json adapter cannot read XML.

name: AES Ohio (Dayton Power & Light)
notes: Public XML behind the outage map; regex reads the utility total from <Message><TotalOut>. The same XML has <Counties><County>/<TotOut> for 24 counties, so a small XML-capable adapter would give real county data.

name: MidAmerican Energy
notes: POST (empty JSON body) to the OutageWatch API behind the map. Only counties with active outages are listed, so no served total is taken (PremiseCount would be partial). NumOutages sums to the same total as the city and incident endpoints. County rows carry no state (Iowa, Illinois Quad Cities, South Dakota), so names like Polk are ambiguous. Idle system returns an empty list.

name: Minnesota Power (ALLETE)
notes: ArcGIS Online hosted layer behind the outage dashboards; one point per incident with CUSTCOUNT. Layer was empty when checked, so a LOCATION text field exists but its contents are unseen and not used as an area.

name: Otter Tail Power
notes: Public summary JSON used by the outage site (MN, ND, SD combined, ~141k served). /data/outages.json holds incidents (empty when checked) if a later pass wants more.

name: Duke Energy Indiana
notes: embedded-key: the map's Angular app sends an Authorization Basic header (credential shipped in the page JS) to prod.apigee.duke-energy.app; not recorded here. County data exists; jurisdiction code from the page script is DEI.

name: Duke Energy Ohio / Kentucky
notes: embedded-key: same Authorization Basic header as Duke Indiana (shipped in page JS, not recorded). Jurisdiction code in the page script for Ohio and Kentucky is DEM. Feed also covers Duke's Kentucky customers.

Dataset index 1 is County (6 rows, spanning Wisconsin and Illinois, so no single state is set); index 0 is ZIP. Served from county rows is ~18.4k of 19.9k total.

name: Minnesota Valley Electric Cooperative
notes: Hosted co-op map platform (outagemap-data.cloud.coop/<slug>/Hosted_Outage_Map/summary.json): regionDataSets hold ZIP, county and township/service-area rows with numberOut and numberServed. Dataset index 1 is County (9 rows); index 0 is a single service-area row.

name: Connexus Energy
notes: Map is on the cloud.coop hosted platform, but its data bucket (outagemap-data.cloud.coop/connexus/Hosted_Outage_Map/config.json) returns 403 AccessDenied even to the page itself, so the map shows nothing public. Not reporting to ODIN by the names seen today.

name: Corridor Energy Cooperative

name: Missouri Electric Cooperatives
notes: Statewide association report, per co-op and county. Co-ops with their own feed are excluded.
